subject: Next step: short product walkthrough & pick a time for ops + tech

From: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.ai>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-04-27T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Next step: short product walkthrough & pick a time for ops + tech

Hi Becca —

Great to connect on the discovery call today. Quick recap from our side: EdgeLens is focused on reducing inference cost for your customer support automation pipeline while preserving latency for real-time routing. We heard that the primary evaluation criteria are: throughput at peak, per-call cost, and a clear rollback/compatibility plan for your existing model stack.

Recommended next step is a focused 30-minute product walkthrough (no sales fluff) with ops + one technical stakeholder so we can demonstrate the runtime and answer integration questions. Please pick the slot that works best for your team:

- Option A: Wednesday, May 5 — 10:00–10:30 PT / 13:00–13:30 ET
- Option B: Thursday, May 6 — 15:00–15:30 PT / 18:00–18:30 ET

If neither works, happy to do A/B (we can also shift to Tue/early week). For the walkthrough agenda: 1) 10 min product demo (latency/cost controls), 2) 10 min infra/connectivity (VPC/SSO/keys), 3) 10 min Q&A + next steps.

Attachments: redwood-briefing-deck.pdf (slide highlights), call-recording-20260422.mp3 (recording of discovery).

Can you confirm who from your side will join (names/roles)? We want to include our platform engineer (Priyom Das) for the infra and a solutions lead (Karthik) to run the demo.

Thanks —
Olga Petrov
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
